title: Water Damage Mitigation Tear-Out Antimicrobial Treatment Line
content:
Surfaces laid open by tear-out on a Water Damage Mitigation job are treated with antimicrobial and billed to the job as a tear-out antimicrobial line in square feet.

## Scope
The job must be in authorized, drying or drying complete status when a mitigation service line is charged. Every mitigation service line other than a tear-out antimicrobial line, a tear-out debris haul-off line and a final HEPA vacuuming line remains billed at the unit rate of the job's tier for its service code multiplied by the quantity performed: extraction, antimicrobial, pad and carpet work and HEPA vacuuming by the square foot, flood cuts and baseboard by the linear foot, contents manipulation by the room, debris by the load, PPE by the technician-day, labor by the hour, and moisture mapping, thermal imaging, containment, dumpster, lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling by the each; for a job's tear-out antimicrobial line, and only for that line, the treated area, the coverage and the unit rate are set by the company's tear-out antimicrobial pricing, while the debris haul-off and final HEPA vacuuming lines are set by their own rules.

## Business effect
Booking the line adds one antimicrobial charge, in square feet, to the job's charge list and raises the job's balance due by the line amount; the customer sees the line and the higher balance.

## Invoking the booking tool
`book_tearout_antimicrobial_173ee43e` is an agent-side tool: the desk agent unlocks it and then calls it. The call books one antimicrobial application charge line, billed by the square foot, on the named Water Damage Mitigation job. The tool records what it is given; it does not work out any value.

### Parameters
- `water_job_id` — the reference number of the water mitigation job whose surfaces were treated, as read from the water mitigation job lookup.
- `service_date` — the calendar date the antimicrobial line is dated, written YYYY-MM-DD with no time and no time zone; never empty.
- `square_feet` — the billed square feet, a positive number with up to 2 decimal places, already rounded half up before the call (unit: square foot).
- `unit_rate` — the rate per square foot in USD, a positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up before the call.
- `amount` — the line amount in USD, a positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up before the call.

### Return
On success the tool returns a text receipt of the form "Booked antimicrobial charge <charge reference> on job <job reference>: <square feet> sq ft at <rate> ...", continuing with the line amount and the job's balance due after the line ("balance due now <balance> USD"); the charge reference is the new line's reference number and the amounts are USD with 2 decimals. The call has succeeded when the receipt starts with "Booked". A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: the date was not written YYYY-MM-DD, the square feet, rate or amount was not positive or carried more than 2 decimal places, or no water mitigation job has that reference number.
